summary.text: Dylan Wegela is a Democratic state representative from Michigan House District 26 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Chris Dobis. He is a public school teacher by profession.

paragraphs.text: Dylan Wegela was born in Detroit, Michigan, and earned a high school diploma from Franklin High School and a bachelor's degree in secondary education from Eastern Michigan University.
His career experience includes working as a public school teacher, and he co-founded Arizona Educators United.
Wegela won the District 26 seat in the November 8, 2022 general election, defeating Republican James Townsend, and was re-elected on November 5, 2024 over Republican Jeff Gorman.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
In the 2023-2024 session he served on the Education, Elections (as majority vice chair) and House Oversight committees, among others; in 2025-2026 he is assigned to the House Oversight Committee.
